dtsPropsFor.ErrorBoundary:
/** Subtree to guard. A render error inside it swaps in the full-page fallback with a retry action. */
  children?: React.ReactNode;
dtsPropsFor.ConfirmProvider:
/** App subtree that may call `useConfirm()`. The dialog renders as a sibling of these children. */
  children?: React.ReactNode;
dtsPropsFor.LoadingState:
/** Text shown beside the spinner. Defaults to "Carregando...". */
  message?: React.ReactNode;
dtsPropsFor.ForbiddenState:
/** Explanation under the "Acesso restrito" heading. Defaults to the standard permission message. */
  message?: React.ReactNode;
dtsPropsFor.Layout:
/** Page content rendered below the global Navbar. */
  children?: React.ReactNode;
dtsPropsFor.Navbar: /** Navbar takes no props: it reads the session from the auth context and renders the global links itself. */
